name: TekNet Canberra
summary: Canberra ISP (TekNet Computer Services est. 1986; ActWEB.NET brand); dormant ~2007-09 (ACN 058 198 208).

events.details: Dormant. actweb.net identity folded into WebOne by 2001 and became a bare redirect in Apr 2006; TekNet's company GST registration ended 29 Jun 2007, so c.2007 suits better than 2008 or 2007-09.

refs.label: Canberra entity (ACT 2601/2602) GST registration ended 29 Jun 2007 (a later re-registration 2013-22 post-dates the ISP brand).
actweb.net was already a WebOne portal Sep 2001; remains so to 2005.
From Apr 2006 actweb.net is only a redirect to WebOne (unchanged to Dec 2023).
ABR: TEKNET COMPUTER SERVICES PTY. LTD. ACN 058 198 208
